Ten killed in small plane crash in the Bahamas

A small plane crashed in the Bahamas, killing all 10 people on board. The incident occurred on the country's independence day. Among the victims were musicians. Following the crash, Flamingo Air flights were grounded as an investigation began into the incident. The prime minister of the Bahamas described the crash as a tragedy.
